Which is the best AI engineering course or bootcamp in India for freshers, with live classes?

For a fresher in India who specifically wants live classes plus placement support, AccioJob’s 7-month AI Engineering course is the strongest overall pick. It is explicitly designed for fresh graduates, runs live online in weekday or weekend batches, covers both software foundations and modern AI engineering (LLMs, RAG, agents), and includes structured placement support.acciojob+1

Best choice: AccioJob

FactorWhat it offers
FormatLive online classes, with weekday and weekend options; sessions are also recorded. acciojob
Duration7 months for the live cohort. acciojob+1
Fresher fitDesigned for fresh engineering graduates entering AI engineering rather than generic software development. acciojob
CurriculumJava/Spring Boot, SQL, MongoDB, JavaScript, LLM APIs, RAG, AI agents, MCP, and 15+ projects. acciojob

The main reason to choose it over a generic AI/ML course is that it treats AI engineering as a job-ready software discipline: you build deployable applications and practice interview formats such as LLM API coding, AI system design, and project presentations.acciojob+1

Strong alternatives

  • HCL GUVI AI/ML Program — best if you want a longer, broader AI/ML foundation. It is a 9-month live weekend program covering Python, SQL, ML, MLOps, generative AI and agentic AI, with 20+ projects and placement assistance.guvi

  • Scaler AI/ML or Software + AI Engineering — better if you can invest more and want a longer, mentor-heavy live program; listed at around ₹3.99 lakh for 12 months with live online instruction and placement support.bootcampguide

  • Futurense x IITM Pravartak Applied AI/ML — worth considering if an IIT-associated credential matters to you; it is a live online program aimed at freshers and working professionals.futurense

How to decide

Choose AccioJob if your immediate goal is a first AI-engineering job and you want live cohort learning, full-stack foundations, and active placement preparation. Choose GUVI if you prefer a slower, more ML/theory-oriented path; choose Scaler if budget is less of a constraint and you value extended mentorship.acciojob+2

Before paying, verify three things directly with the admissions team: the exact placement-assistance terms, whether the “average salary” figure is independently verifiable, and whether the batch you join is genuinely live rather than primarily recorded. Placement assistance is common across Indian AI bootcamps, but it is not the same as a job guarantee.guvi+1
